limits: Rollout and Loom sources only, synthetic content in temporary homes; host transcripts and System One episodes are T008 (procedure_006 is recaptured then). Loom carries no model text or reward, which the loss notes state. Refused content stubs carry no attempt, so content-refused is a run-level note. Redaction limits are those of procedure_003 and procedure_004.
outcome: passed: T007: lightning_adapter turns one attempt's SPEC-070 events plus its redacted content records into braid-lightning-triplet/v0.1 records, one per model_request, and braid-lightning-messages/v0.1 user and assistant turns; the committed Loom corpus becomes one triplet per strand and one system message per event. Every text is redacted with the run salt and post-scanned (redaction classes counted), and each record carries source, sourceSha256 and sorted loss notes. Rewards match by first-occurrence (nearest earlier unrewarded request) or first-sibling (others refused with reward-match); a second content record for one request is ignored with content-duplicate. Outputs are deterministic for the same inputs and salt. Without consent, or for an unlisted source, prompt, response and messages are null or empty with content-consent-required while rewards stay. An unparseable Loom stream or an unknown attempt is refused with source-invalid. Negative control: with redaction switched off a canary in a Loom label reaches the output and the clean check fails.
